body: draw_hero_box/draw_hero_model take a squish factor for classic squash-and-stretch bounce, triggered by damage/spell-cast/movement-start transitions. Found+fixed a zero-init bug (squish_age_ms defaulting to 0.0f read as 'just triggered' not neutral) before it shipped. Client-only, no protocol changes. Verified: clean build, full headless suite (337 checks), VS0/VS1 stability. Commit 2874de8.
